proof.interpretation: Thirty-five published drawn-layer purposes are checked for straddling each supplied module-cut polygon on 81:10. Diffusion is checked for straddling seal 81:1; tap, poly, li1 and met1-met5 are checked for positive-area seal overlap. Targets are merged connected regions. Boundary polygons must be disjoint and non-touching so merging cannot hide an internal boundary. Manhattan polygons and exact orthogonal paths are supported. Missing boundary geometry does not establish chip/frame completeness or waive any enclosure or spacing requirement. Five package-layer scribe records remain separate.

scope: Forty-four numerical boundary-interaction checks are mandatory in Finish and saved-result validation. These reference blocks have no module-cut or seal markers; their absence proves no supplied-boundary crossing, not completeness of a chip frame or an exemption from enclosure/spacing. Nonempty controls are separate. The original catalog retains 529 unreviewed records; historical decisions remain bound to their exact GDS.
